synopsis: The glossary identifies EN 50126, alongside EN 50128 and EN 50129, as European railway standards covering reliability and safety management, software and electronic signaling [f15359]. Chapter 10 states that EN 50126 was not verified in this research, a gap repeated in the glossary [f7716, f15361]. The research also did not verify risk scaling, validation against physical data, validity envelopes and transfer rules, or remaining physical evidence for the listed standards, including EN 50126–50129 [f8155]. Consequently, the booklet leaves EN 50126’s relevance to off-road automatic braking unverified rather than establishing it as applicable guidance [f8155].

relations.note: The glossary repeats Chapter 10’s verification gap for the same four standards.
Specifies unverified validation aspects and relevance to off-road automatic braking.
Adds specific validation and applicability gaps to the glossary’s general verification warning.
